title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: Late-Delivery Fee Refund Amount
content:
**Payments & Refunds desk statement.**

The late-delivery fee refund on a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase is the fulfillment fee charged on the order multiplied by the refund share, rounded half up to the cent once at the end, and never more than the fulfillment fee charged less the fulfillment fee already refunded. The refund share is 25%.

## Definitions

- **Fulfillment fee charged** - the fees charged on the order other than redelivery fees.
- **Fulfillment fee already refunded** - the fee refunds on the order other than refunds of redelivery fees.
- **Refund share** - 25% of the fulfillment fee charged.

## Order of the figures

1. The fulfillment fee charged is multiplied by the refund share.
2. That figure is held to the fulfillment fee charged less the fulfillment fee already refunded; the lower of the two stands.
3. The result is rounded half up to the cent, once.

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

| Fulfillment fee charged | Already refunded | Fee times 25% | Room left | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $12.00 | $0.00 | $3.00 | $12.00 | $3.00 |
| $12.00 | $10.00 | $3.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 |
| $12.00 fee plus a $49.00 redelivery fee | $0.00 | $3.00 (the redelivery fee is not part of the fulfillment fee) | $12.00 | $3.00 |

An order that does not meet the conditions for a late-delivery fee refund receives nothing.
